title: R2 RESEARCH: operationalizing the load-bearing citation - counterfactual dependence as a v1 verifier heuristic
description: Section A.6.3 of the addendum is a DIRECTIVE plus an explicit research assignment: a citation counts as a reputation event only when it is LOAD-BEARING - the cited ratio actually constrained the citing decision, confirmed at verification time, not merely named in prose. The candidate test the addendum names is counterfactual dependence: would the decision have differed had the cited rule not existed. Your job is to operationalize it. Cover, with named sources: legal but-for causation and where it breaks (overdetermination, multiple sufficient causes, and the doctrinal patches - substantial factor, NESS); the citation-analysis literature on distinguishing perfunctory or name-drop citation from organic or load-bearing citation, including the measured reliability of those classifications; and evidence law on materiality and relevance. The addendum names the failure mode to avoid by analogy: the anti-loss guard's documented false positive, where a note that merely MENTIONED a forbidden word blocked an innocent command - the use-mention distinction failing in a classifier, which is citation gaming's exact shape with money attached. DELIVERABLE: a v1 heuristic a VERIFIER can run at confirmation time, explicitly PROVISIONAL with a decay clock, per the addendum's own instruction to treat any v1 heuristic as provisional doctrine. Output docs/precedent-research/13-load-bearing-citation.md. THIS TASK IS ON THE CRITICAL PATH: T-368 depends on it and on nothing else, so a section left as a placeholder blocks the entire build half.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE (create only this): docs/precedent-research/13-load-bearing-citation.md. Use mkdir -p on the parent (idempotent, race-safe with T-366). Do NOT create or edit docs/precedent-research/README.md (owned solely by T-375), 01..12, any synthesis document, PRECEDENT.md, INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, any record, or anything else under .harness/.

WEB RESEARCH IS REQUIRED: at least 6 named sources, of which at least 3 are PRIMARY (a judgment with case name and citation, a codified rule of evidence or statute, or a peer-reviewed article with named authors, journal and year). Every source in a final Sources section with a retrievable identifier plus retrieval date. Cover all three literatures - causation, citation analysis, evidence law - with at least one primary source each.
EVERY substantive claim carries exactly one tag: ESTABLISHED / ANALOGY / SPECULATION. An untagged substantive claim is a defect and grounds for REJECT.

SUBSTANCE FLOOR, all four answered explicitly with sources: (a) how law tests counterfactual dependence, where but-for fails, and the named doctrinal patches; (b) how the citation-analysis literature separates perfunctory from organic citation, what signals it uses, and how reliable those classifications measured out; (c) how evidence law tests materiality and relevance and what that adds beyond causation; (d) the use-mention distinction - what the sources say about avoiding the mention-counted-as-use failure, mapped explicitly onto the anti-loss guard false positive the addendum cites.

THE DELIVERABLE IS A TEST A VERIFIER CAN RUN, NOT AN ESSAY: a NUMBERED v1 heuristic, each step stated as an observable question with a decision rule, evaluable by the CONFIRMING identity at confirm time from artifacts that ALREADY EXIST - the citing record's ratio and relations, the cited record's ratio and scope_conditions, the citing task's notes, the diff. For EACH step state whether it is MECHANIZABLE (computable from registry data with no judgment) or JUDGMENT (requires the confirming agent to answer in writing). This split is the load-bearing part of the document: T-371 can implement only the mechanizable half, and it is required to print the judgment half as not-computed rather than guess it.

MUST STATE THE FALSE-POSITIVE AND FALSE-NEGATIVE PROFILE of your heuristic: which gaming strategy defeats it (for example a cartel that writes plausible counterfactual notes), and which honest citation it wrongly demotes. A heuristic with no stated failure profile is not provisional doctrine, it is a guess.

MUST BE EXPLICITLY PROVISIONAL WITH A DECAY CLOCK: state a revisit trigger in the exact shape precedent.py's --revisit-trigger field takes (a named observable plus a threshold), and include the section A.8 convergence indicator - if load-bearing and name-drop citation counts converge, gaming is succeeding. Say in plain words what observation would retire your heuristic.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Implications for the agent harness': name the exact confirm-time surface - precedent.py confirm (SDR-24/25), confirmation_note, confirmed_by, cited_by, relations[].type, and the existing rules inside qualifying_applications_count (same-publisher exclusion, below_target_tier, the distinguishes and corrective-reinterpretation zeroing) - and for each heuristic step say which field carries the answer, or that a NEW field would be needed. If a new field would be needed, state that Phase A cannot add it without a published record (PR-017 procedure), so the step is deferred rather than improvised.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Extends, does not duplicate': address by name docs/precedent-research/02-ratio-identification.md (declared vs extracted ratio), 04-distinguishing-anti-evasion.md (the eight detection signals), 07-failure-modes.md (citation inflation and clusters), PR-015 and PR-016, and PRECEDENT.md sections 10.4 and 20 (the fact re-description constraint). For each, EXTENDS or DUPLICATE, with the reason.

MUST STATE AT LEAST ONE FINDING THAT CUTS AGAINST SECTION A.6.3 ITSELF - candidate, not mandate: whether self-reported counterfactual dependence is decidable at all by the confirming identity, and what the sources say about self-reported counterfactuals. If the sources support no counter-finding, say so and say why.
SCOPE: no code, no registry writes, no records, no edits under .harness/. You specify the heuristic; T-368 fixes what ships and T-371 implements only its mechanizable subset.

VERIFICATION TIER: DOC TIER per P-024 (brief replay: path, tagging, Sources counts, both mandatory sections with exact titles, spot-check 2 sources). But state in your handoff that T-368 CONSUMES this document as its ONLY research dependency, so any placeholder section blocks the build half - a doc with an unanswered substance-floor item hands off blocked, not done.

Hand off with `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier --agent <you>` (never self-mark done). The note must list the numbered heuristic steps with their MECHANIZABLE / JUDGMENT labels, the revisit trigger verbatim, and every OPEN-QUESTION the operationalization exposed.

THE v1 HEURISTIC (7 numbered steps, doc S5):
1. Relation-existence gate [MECHANIZABLE] -- relations[].target vs bare cites[] membership; no
   relations[] entry to X = NOT load-bearing, stop.
2. Relation-type routing [MECHANIZABLE] -- relations[].type; "distinguishes" = NOT load-bearing
   for X by definition (stop); "overrules"/"supersedes"/"voids" = out of scope, route to
   PRECEDENT.md S7's overruling protocol; "follows"/"reinterprets" = proceed.
3. Same-publisher exclusion [MECHANIZABLE] -- published_by on both records; reuses
   qualifying_applications_count's own filter verbatim (precedent.py:1290-1291).
4. Below-target-tier exclusion [MECHANIZABLE] -- relations[].below_target_tier; reuses the same
   filter verbatim (precedent.py:1295-1296).
5. Grounding-in-record exhibit [MECHANIZABLE, produces an exhibit only, never a verdict] --
   difflib comparison of X's ratio/dicta against Y's issuing task's own prior notes/diff; models
   04-distinguishing-anti-evasion.md's S-07 signal, extended to the follows direction.
6. Counterfactual-dependence verdict [JUDGMENT] -- Wambaugh inversion (02-ratio-identification.md
   S1.1) applied to the citation edge: state Y's holding, subtract X's ratio, ask whether Y's own
   stated reasoning still reaches it. MUST be rendered by an identity distinct from BOTH X's and
   Y's published_by (extends SDR-24.1 one register). NO EXISTING FIELD CARRIES THIS ANSWER:
   confirmation_note/confirmed_by (precedent.py:1200-1203) are a single scalar per RECORD (X's own
   scope lifecycle) and cannot hold N independent per-citation-edge verdicts; relations[] has no
   load_bearing field. Per PR-017, Phase A cannot mint either field without a published record --
   so v1's verdict is NOT written to the registry at all; it lives only as free-text on the
   confirming task's own U2 DECISION: note.
7. Grounding verdict on step 5's exhibit [JUDGMENT] -- Hosie's four-part factual-revisionism
   anatomy (PRECEDENT.md S11) applied to the exhibit; same field gap as step 6, same note.

REVISIT TRIGGER, verbatim from the document's S7 (named observable + threshold, precedent.py
--revisit-trigger shape):
"Revisit this heuristic when either observable crosses its threshold: (a) the SS.8 convergence
indicator -- the count of citations rendered load-bearing under Step 6 and the count rendered
name-drop (or left explicitly not-computed) under the same step trend toward equal, operationalized
as: the ratio of load-bearing-confirmed citations to all Step-6-answered citations (excluding
not-computed) drops below 0.5 across any 10 or more citations targeting the same cited record, or
across 30 or more citations registry-wide within one epic -- the addendum's own SA.8 language,
verbatim in effect: 'if load-bearing and name-drop citation counts converge... the currency is
failing'; or (b) confirmer-identity concentration -- a single confirming identity renders more
than 60% of all Step-6 load-bearing verdicts registry-wide with at least 5 rendered (mirroring
S-04's existing threshold shape). Either crossing retires v1 and routes to PRECEDENT.md S12's
adjudication mechanism for a v2 heuristic; neither crossing auto-demotes any single citation or
record -- per A.4/A.9, Phase A flags, it never fines."

FALSE-POSITIVE / FALSE-NEGATIVE PROFILE (doc S6):
- False positive (gaming vector that defeats it): a coordinated pair/cluster of confirming
  identities mutually renders each other's citations "load-bearing" with plausible free-text
  notes, since steps 6-7 land in no structurally-verdicted field and nothing mechanically blocks
  confirmer rotation within a cluster -- the single-citation-grain instance of 07's own
  SPECULATION-tagged citation-cartel risk (S-13), not solved here.
- False negative (honest citation wrongly demoted): a terse, obviously-necessary compliance-tier
  citation (07's own "lock before writing any file" example) whose author never narrates it at
  length precisely because its necessity is too obvious to spell out -- step 5's exhibit shows
  thin overlap for exactly the healthiest, most routine, most load-bearing citations, risking
  systematic under-crediting if a confirming agent reads "thin narration" as "thin dependence."

OPEN-QUESTION (1): Step 6/7's verdict has no schema field to land in, and Phase A/PR-017 blocks
minting one now. The document recommends a future relations[].load_bearing (enum) +
relations[].load_bearing_note on the relation object itself (mirroring where below_target_tier
already lives) as the PR-017 candidate -- T-368 must decide whether to authorize that record or
accept that v1 ships judgment-only, forever off-registry.
OPEN-QUESTION (2): cited_by (SDR-19.3/19.4, precedent.py:1220-1247) is populated identically for a
bare cites[] token and a typed relations[] entry alike -- T-371 (reputation.py) MUST NOT use raw
len(cited_by) as a "load-bearing citations received" proxy; doing so silently re-imports the exact
name-drop-counts-the-same-as-load-bearing failure this task exists to retire. The document's own
recommended v1 output for reputation.py is either a labeled upper bound (citations clearing steps
1-4 only) or a literal "not computed" line -- T-368/T-371 must pick one, not both silently.
OPEN-QUESTION (3): no existing mechanism enforces that the confirming identity for steps 6-7 differ
from BOTH the citing and the cited record's publisher -- SDR-24.1 as shipped only protects the
CITED record's own author from self-confirming scope, and says nothing about the CITING author
confirming their own citation's materiality. Named as an open gap, not claimed as covered (same
shape as 04-distinguishing-anti-evasion.md's own item-3 finding, extended one register).
OPEN-QUESTION (4): the document's mandatory "cuts against A.6.3" finding (S9): self-reported, and
even third-party-reconstructed, counterfactual dependence is not confidently decidable -- four
converging data points (Price Waterhouse's burden-shifting design; the citation-classification
literature's uniform reliance on third-party coding, never author self-report; Bagley's neutral-
adjudicator materiality standard; and this environment's own regression-blindness figures,
papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:9, showing ~2x-random reliability on a structurally
identical counterfactual-shaped self-report question). T-368 should treat steps 6-7 as
permanently JUDGMENT and never elevate them to a mechanical gate or a binding structural field,
consistent with SA.9's own floor ("no automatic consequence attaches to any signal whose
underlying identity is unverified").
